component.name: FluxCut
component.summary: Lightweight, native Linux desktop video editor

description.p: FluxCut is a native Linux video editor designed for quick cuts, social media formatting, and audio replacements without the overhead of heavy professional NLEs.

ul.li: Instant timeline trimming, splitting, and gap deletion
Vertical video (9:16 Shorts/Reels), Square (1:1), and Landscape presets
Audio muting, track mixing, and background music layering
GPU-accelerated preview with DMA-BUF on Wayland and software fallback
Deterministic export with fast-path stream-copy when re-encoding is not required
